🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT! 👻
🍬 Turn Entities into Candy for the Halloween Shop!
🥚 11 new Entities, a NEW rarity, 3 rebirths & a quest NPC!

🎁 Codes: "HALLOWEEN" & "RELEASE"

🎮 HOW TO PLAY:
🌊 Collect eggs from the river, grow them & hatch entities!
💥 Careful - eggs can explode!
🌳 Keep big entities in your garden, expand & rebirth!

🐔 500+ Variations | ✨ 8+ Mutations

👍 Like & favourite to support updates! ⭐
